descriptionFull:
Multi-select picker built on Radix Popover + Checkbox. Sibling to `<Select>` for cases where consumers need to pick more than one option (filter rows, multi-target actions, tag-style inputs). The popover stays open on toggle; Esc / outside-click closes it. Selected values render as removable chips in the trigger, with an optional "clear all" affordance and a `+N more` overflow chip via `maxSelectedDisplay`.

Controlled vs uncontrolled is decided by the presence of `value` (mirrors Radix Select's convention): pass `value` for controlled, `defaultValue` for uncontrolled

props.name: options
props.description: `{ value, label, disabled? }` entries to render as option rows

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values. Omit to use `defaultValue` for uncontrolled mode

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial values for uncontrolled mode. Ignored when `value` is provided

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next array on toggle / chip remove / clear-all

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger (popover does not open)

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger sizing tokens. Mirror the `<Select>` sizes

props.name: variant
props.description: `'colored'` paints the trigger in the primary tint (matches `<Select>`'s colored variant)

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Rendered inside the popover when `options` is empty

props.name: maxSelectedDisplay
props.description: Max number of selected chips rendered in the trigger before collapsing the rest into a "+N more" badge. `undefined` (de…
props.descriptionFull: Max number of selected chips rendered in the trigger before collapsing the rest into a "+N more" badge. `undefined` (default) renders every chip

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the trigger button

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Extra class on the popover content

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label - applied to the trigger button

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value added to or removed from the selection; matched by strict equality, and also the React key

fields.name: label
fields.description: Shown in the option row and on the selected chip; a string label also names the chip's remove button

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Option is shown but cannot be toggled from the list; an already-selected one can still be removed via its chip
